verified_claims.locator: 2008 daily Gold London Fixing table; rows for 17 Mar, 15 Sep, 15 Oct, 24 Oct 2008
verified_claims.notes: London fixing benchmark; not COMEX intraday futures prices.

verified_claims.claim: 以2008年3月17日与10月24日伦敦定盘价计算，峰谷回撤约32.3%；9月15日至10月15日约上涨8.9%。
verified_claims.polarity: contradicts the claim that the whole 32% fall occurred in the month after Lehman
verified_claims.locator: Derived from the listed London fixing observations
verified_claims.notes: Percentage calculations use the same benchmark and explicit endpoints.

verified_claims.claim: 按LBMA黄金价格口径，黄金2008年全年收益约+4.3%，年末约869.75美元/盎司。
verified_claims.locator: Article text discussing gold performance during 2008
verified_claims.notes: World Gold Council is an industry body; its annual return claim is attributed to LBMA price data.

verified_claims.claim: 2020年3月黄金在跨资产清算中承压；高流动性、杠杆头寸和规则化交易是同期评论提出的解释。
verified_claims.locator: 19 March 2020 commentary, lines discussing liquidation and gold liquidity
verified_claims.notes: Does not independently verify a universal two-week -12% figure.

verified_claims.claim: 2020年3月美国国债和机构MBS市场功能恶化，投资者出售长期资产转向短期流动性资产。
verified_claims.locator: June 2020 Monetary Policy Report, section on Treasury and MBS market functioning

verified_claims.claim: 2020年3月底美国优质货币市场基金出现约1,600亿美元赎回，杠杆投资者因保证金要求被迫平仓，国债亦承压。
verified_claims.locator: Annual Economic Report 2020, Chapter I, subsection 'A financial sudden stop'
verified_claims.notes: BIS reports roughly 15% of assets under management.

verified_claims.polarity: supports the local-index drawdown, not a global equity generalization
verified_claims.locator: SSE Statistics Annual table: Data of SSE Composite Index, 1992–2020
verified_claims.notes: Index extrema are not a total-return portfolio result.

verified_claims.claim: 美国Case-Shiller全国指数2006年7月至2012年2月下跌27.4%，20城市指数2006年7月至2012年3月下跌35.1%。
verified_claims.polarity: supports a historical US housing price drawdown
verified_claims.notes: Price index does not directly measure individual property liquidity or sale time.

verified_claims.claim: 中国2026年1—10月房地产开发投资同比-21.6%、新建商品房销售面积-13.7%、销售额-14.3%，二手住房网签交易面积+11.4%。
verified_claims.polarity: shows market segmentation rather than uniform freeze
verified_claims.notes: Official national aggregate; does not describe every city or property segment.

verified_claims.claim: 2026年10月70城新建商品住宅价格指数显示上海同比102.7、郑州95.8、昆明95.7。
verified_claims.locator: Table 1: new commercial residential building price indices
verified_claims.notes: Index base is same month previous year=100; statistical index is not an individual property valuation.

verified_claims.claim: 美联储2007年9月已开始降息；2008年10月8日和10月29日继续降息，10月29日目标利率降至1%。
verified_claims.polarity: contradicts a single late-stage policy-switch date
verified_claims.notes: Rate cuts began before the Lehman bankruptcy.

verified_claims.claim: 美联储2008年11月25日宣布计划购买最多1,000亿美元机构债务和5,000亿美元机构MBS。
verified_claims.locator: Timeline: Balance Sheet Policies, 25 November 2008 entry
verified_claims.notes: Announcement of purchase intention, not same-day completed purchases.

verified_claims.claim: IMF 2026年10月WEO基准预测全球经济2027年增长3.4%，同时强调下行风险。
verified_claims.polarity: contextual evidence only; not a crisis probability
verified_claims.notes: Baseline projections do not rule out tail risks.

verified_claims.claim: IMF 2026年10月GFSR认为市场仍具韧性但金融稳定风险偏高，指出AI估值、主权债收益率、网络风险及非银行机构流动性错配等脆弱性。
verified_claims.polarity: supports monitoring systemic vulnerabilities, not exact crisis timing
verified_claims.notes: Risk assessment is not a date-specific crisis forecast.

verified_claims.claim: 黄金与股票同跌／反向走势可以可靠识别危机阶段。
verified_claims.locator: No operational rule or backtest supplied by the original commentary
verified_claims.notes: Requires defined benchmark, horizon, threshold, transaction costs, false-positive/negative rates and out-of-sample tests.

verified_claims.claim: 2027年7—9月发生全球金融危机、2027年9月黄金见底、2028年初必然放水。
verified_claims.locator: Compared against the reviewed IMF WEO and GFSR public outlooks
verified_claims.notes: No public model, calibrated probability, trigger definition or out-of-sample record was supplied; absence in these reports is not proof the event cannot occur.

limitations: 本研究是公开资料的部分核验，不是完整跨资产日频回测。
2008年黄金价格采用伦敦定盘价；不能与COMEX盘中高低价混用。
2020年黄金短期跌幅对起止日期、现货/期货、时区和计价货币敏感；本轮未将原文的12%作为已核实定值。
世界黄金协会是黄金行业组织，其研究数据应与交易所、央行和国际组织资料交叉阅读。
美国Case-Shiller房价指数不能直接推断中国房地产的流动性。
IMF基准预测和金融稳定报告会随新数据修订；风险识别不等于预测危机发生月份。
尚未对黄金—股票相对强弱信号进行量化回测、样本外验证和交易成本模拟。
next_action: 建立2007—2012、2020年2—6月、2022年通胀加息周期的统一日频多资产数据集，定义黄金—股票分化规则，进行样本外回测并记录胜率、误报率、漏报率、最大回撤与交易成本。
